text.id: Nih.
text.en: Here.

text.id: Dinda nyodorin HP Android jadul dengan casing retak. Wallpaper lock screen-nya foto dermaga waktu subuh. Perahu kayu, langit oranye, dan laut yang masih abu-abu.
text.en: Dinda hands me an old Android phone in a cracked case. The lock screen wallpaper is a photo of a pier at dawn. A wooden boat, an orange sky, and sea that's still grey.

text.id: Empat kotak kosong di tengah layar, nunggu diisi.
text.en: Four empty boxes in the middle of the screen, waiting.

text.id: Kak Sekar selalu pake jam buat sandinya. Katanya angka yang paling gampang diinget itu angka yang ada ceritanya.
text.en: Sekar always uses a time for her passcodes. She says the easiest numbers to remember are the ones with a story.

text.id: Gue udah coba jam dia lahir, jam Ayah meninggal, jam podcast-nya pertama tayang. Salah semua. Sisa berapa kali coba sebelum HP-nya ngunci, gue nggak tahu.
text.en: I tried the time she was born, the time Dad died, the time her podcast first aired. All wrong. I don't know how many tries are left before it locks.

text.id: Jam yang ada ceritanya.{w} "Ka. Inget jam lima pagi itu?"
text.en: A time with a story.{w} "Ka. Remember five in the morning?"

text.id: Masukkan kode empat angka.
text.en: Enter the four-digit code.

text.id: Kode salah
text.en: Wrong code

text.id: Bukan. Mikir, Raka. Jam yang ada ceritanya buat dia. Dan buat gue.
text.en: No. Think, Raka. A time with a story for her. And for me.

text.id: Dermaga. Subuh. Kapal.{w} Wallpaper-nya bukan kebetulan.
text.en: The pier. Dawn. A boat.{w} The wallpaper isn't a coincidence.

text.id: Kode salah
text.en: Wrong code

text.id: Hampir. Jam lima itu jam ketemuannya. Tapi kapalnya nggak berangkat jam lima.
text.en: Close. Five was when we were supposed to meet. But the boat didn't leave at five.

text.id: Jadwal kapal di papan gabusnya. Yang dilingkarin itu jam berapa?
text.en: The ferry schedule on her corkboard. What time was circled?

text.id: Gue tutup mata. Tanggul. Es teh yang esnya cair. "Kapalnya Pak Karta berangkat jam setengah enam. Lo ikut, kan?"
text.en: I close my eyes. The seawall. The iced tea with its ice all melted. "Pak Karta's boat leaves at five thirty. You're coming, right?"

text.id: Jari gue ngetik sendiri. Nol. Lima. Tiga. Nol.
text.en: My fingers type it on their own. Zero. Five. Three. Zero.

text.id: Terbuka
text.en: Unlocked

text.id: Sekali coba?? Lo... gimana?
text.en: First try?? How did you...

text.id: Kebuka! Kodenya apa?
text.en: It's open! What was it?

text.id: Lima tiga puluh. Jam kapal yang harusnya gue naikin bareng dia.
text.en: Five thirty. The boat I was supposed to take with her.

text.id: Layar utamanya penuh notifikasi. Grup "Pendengar Ep. 12", sembilan puluh sembilan pesan lebih. Tasya, dua puluh tiga. Bima, empat puluh. Ibu. Nomor-nomor yang nggak disimpen.
text.en: The home screen is full of notifications. The group "Pendengar Ep. 12", ninety-nine plus messages. Tasya, twenty-three. Bima, forty. Mom. Numbers with no name.

text.id: Dan satu chat yang gue kenal. Nama gue sendiri, dengan tanda seru merah di sebelahnya.
text.en: And one chat I know. My own name, with a red exclamation mark beside it.

text.id: Bima itu pacarnya. Udah setahunan. Tasya partner podcast-nya. Dua-duanya bilang nggak tahu apa-apa.
text.en: Bima is her boyfriend. About a year now. Tasya's her podcast partner. Both of them say they don't know anything.

text.id: Bima nanya terus HP cadangannya di mana. Tiga kali kemarin. Gue bilang nggak tahu.
text.en: Bima keeps asking where her spare phone is. Three times yesterday. I said I don't know.

text.id: Baterainya sembilan persen. Apa dulu?
text.en: The battery's at nine percent. What first?

text.id: Cas dulu. Bacanya nanti, pelan-pelan.
text.en: Charge it first. Read it later, carefully.

text.id: Langsung buka chat Bima.
text.en: Open Bima's chat right now.

text.id: Iya. Jangan sampai mati pas lagi baca sesuatu yang penting.
text.en: Yeah. Don't want it dying in the middle of something important.

text.id: Gue buka chat Bima. Layar langsung meredup. "Baterai lemah." Lalu mati.
text.en: I open Bima's chat. The screen dims at once. "Battery low." Then it dies.

text.id: Ka! Ya udah, cas dulu. Sabar dikit kenapa sih.
text.en: Ka! Fine, charge it. Would it kill you to be patient?

text.id: ...Ada yang dateng. Itu mobil polisi.
text.en: ...Someone's here. That's a police car.
